name: Spark
description: A tiny, harmless flicker of flame.

name: Ember
description: A small burning coal that singes the target.

name: Gust
description: A sudden burst of wind that staggers the foe.

name: Splash
description: A jet of water that douses the target.

name: Pebble Toss
description: Conjures and throws a small, sharp stone.

name: Flame Jet
description: A continuous stream of fire.

name: Wind Slash
description: A blade of compressed air that cuts through defenses.

name: Water Whip
description: A whip of pressurized water that can knock items loose.

name: Stone Shard
description: Fires a sharp, crystalline fragment of rock.

name: Firebolt
description: A classic missile of concentrated flame.

name: Shockwave
description: A concussive blast of air that disorients foes.

name: Ice Spike
description: Launches a spear of enchanted ice.

name: Land Spike
description: Causes a sharp pillar of earth to erupt under the target.

name: Scorch
description: Sears an area, leaving behind damaging flames.

name: Chain Lightning
description: A bolt of lightning that arcs to nearby enemies.

name: Freezing Mist
description: A cloud of mist that chills and slows those within it.

name: Entangling Roots
description: Roots burst from the ground to hold a target in place.

name: Fireball
description: An iconic explosion of fire that affects a wide area.

name: Tornado
description: Summons a small tornado that throws enemies into the air.

name: Geyser
description: A powerful jet of water erupts from beneath the target.

name: Earthquake
description: Shakes the ground, damaging all enemies in a radius.

name: Immolate
description: Engulfs a single target in intense, white-hot flames.

name: Suffocate
description: Creates a vacuum around the target's head, preventing spellcasting.

name: Tsunami Wave
description: A massive wave that crashes into and pushes back enemies.

name: Meteor Shower
description: Calls down a rain of fiery meteors from the sky.

name: Thunderstorm
description: Summons a localized storm that lashes foes with lightning.

name: Blizzard
description: A raging blizzard that damages and slows all enemies.

name: Volcanic Eruption
description: Causes a miniature volcano to erupt, showering the area in magma.

name: Solar Flare
description: A blinding flash of pure solar energy.

name: Vortex
description: Creates a vacuum vortex that pulls enemies together.

name: Absolute Zero
description: Flash-freezes a target to its core.

name: Avalanche
description: Summons a cascading wave of rock and snow.

name: Phoenix Dive
description: The caster transforms into a phoenix and dive-bombs the enemy.

name: Sonic Boom
description: A deafening sound wave that deals damage and stuns.

name: Abyssal Tide
description: Summons a wave of dark, crushing deep-sea pressure.

name: Quicksand
description: Turns the ground into quicksand, trapping and damaging foes over time.

name: Inferno
description: Creates a massive, persistent inferno that consumes an area.

name: Vacuum Blast
description: Creates a sphere of vacuum that implodes violently.

name: Ice Age
description: A wave of magical cold that freezes everything in a wide radius.

name: Mountain's Wrath
description: The ground erupts in a massive cataclysm of stone and force.

name: Dragon's Breath
description: Replicates the cone of fire from an ancient dragon.

name: Lightning Tempest
description: A continuous storm of forking lightning bolts.

name: Tidal Wave
description: Summons an enormous tidal wave to crash down on foes.

name: Fissure
description: Splits the earth open, swallowing enemies.

name: Supernova
description: Creates a miniature star that detonates with immense power.

name: Eye of the Storm
description: Creates a massive hurricane with a calm, destructive eye.

name: Glacial Lance
description: Fires a massive, unstoppable lance of glacial ice.

name: Terraform
description: Violently reshapes the landscape, crushing enemies within it.

name: Hellfire
description: Summons black flames from the underworld that burn unceasingly.

name: Atmospheric Collapse
description: Causes the very air to crush inwards upon a large area.

name: Leviathan's Grasp
description: Tentacles of water with the force of the deep sea crush the target.

name: Planetary Crush
description: Focuses gravitational force to crush a target into paste.

name: Cauterize
description: A precise flame that seals wounds, damaging undead and healing allies.

name: Zephyr's Cure
description: A cleansing breeze that blows toxins from a target's body.

name: Purify
description: Washes away poisons and diseases with pure water.

name: Stone mend
description: Uses mineral energy to repair damaged armor on an ally.

name: Flame Ward
description: Grants an ally temporary immunity to fire damage.

name: Wind Wall
description: Creates a wall of swirling wind that blocks arrows and spells.

name: Water Shield
description: Encases an ally in a shield of swirling water that mitigates damage.

name: Stone Skin
description: Hardens the skin of an ally, granting a significant armor bonus.

name: Combust
description: Causes a target to spontaneously ignite from within.

name: Dust Devil
description: A small, sharp whirlwind that scours the target's eyes.

name: Steam Blast
description: Super-heated steam scalds the target.

name: Sand Blast
description: Fires a high-pressure stream of abrasive sand.

name: Searing Ray
description: A concentrated beam of heat that melts through armor.

name: Cyclone
description: Traps a target in a spinning cyclone of wind.

name: Frostbite
description: A touch of extreme cold that slows and damages the target.

name: Petrify
description: Slowly turns an enemy to stone, immobilizing them completely.
